```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  function initCategoryFilter() {
    var buttons = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("button.pub-filter-btn"));
    if (!buttons.length) return;

    var entries = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("article.pub-entry"));
    var yearSections = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("section.pub-year"));
    var publishedSection = document.querySelector("#published-section");
    var preprintsSection = document.querySelector("#preprints-section");
    var statusEl = document.querySelector(".pub-filter-status");

    var validCategories = new Set(
      buttons.map(function (b) { return b.getAttribute("data-category"); }).filter(Boolean)
    );

    function applyFilter(category, updateUrl) {
      var activeCat = validCategories.has(category) ? category : "all";
      var shownCount = 0;

      for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
        var entry = entries[i];
        var raw = (entry.getAttribute("data-categories") || "").trim();
        var tokens = raw ? raw.split(/\s+/) : [];
        var match = activeCat === "all" || tokens.indexOf(activeCat) !== -1;
        entry.hidden = !match;
        if (match) shownCount++;
      }

      for (var j = 0; j < yearSections.length; j++) {
        var sec = yearSections[j];
        var secEntries = sec.querySelectorAll("article.pub-entry");
        var anyInYear = false;
        for (var k = 0; k < secEntries.length; k++) {
          if (!secEntries[k].hidden) {
            anyInYear = true;
            break;
          }
        }
        sec.hidden = !anyInYear;
      }

      var wrappers = [publishedSection, preprintsSection];
      for (var w = 0; w < wrappers.length; w++) {
        var wrapper = wrappers[w];
        if (!wrapper) continue;
        var wrapperEntries = wrapper.querySelectorAll("article.pub-entry");
        var anyInWrapper = false;
        for (var m = 0; m < wrapperEntries.length; m++) {
          if (!wrapperEntries[m].hidden) {
            anyInWrapper = true;
            break;
          }
        }
        wrapper.hidden = !anyInWrapper;
      }

      for (var b = 0; b < buttons.length; b++) {
        var btn = buttons[b];
        var isActive = btn.getAttribute("data-category") === activeCat;
        btn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", isActive ? "true" : "false");
        btn.classList.toggle("active", isActive);
      }

      if (statusEl) {
        statusEl.textContent = activeCat === "all"
          ? ""
          : "Showing " + shownCount + " of " + entries.length + " publications";
      }

      if (updateUrl && window.history && typeof window.history.replaceState === "function") {
        var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        if (activeCat === "all") {
          params.delete("category");
        } else {
          params.set("category", activeCat);
        }
        var qs = params.toString();
        var nextUrl = window.location.pathname + (qs ? "?" + qs : "") + (window.location.hash || "");
        window.history.replaceState(null, "", nextUrl);
      }
    }

    for (var i = 0; i < buttons.length; i++) {
      (function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          applyFilter(btn.getAttribute("data-category") || "all", true);
        });
      })(buttons[i]);
    }

    var initialCat = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("category");
    if (initialCat && initialCat !== "all" && validCategories.has(initialCat)) {
      applyFilter(initialCat, false);
    } else {
      applyFilter("all", false);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initCategoryFilter);
  } else {
    initCategoryFilter();
  }
})();
</script>
```
